description: Fixed evaluation briefs for AI Growth Agent V0.1.

input.product_description: Real-time AI translation earbuds designed for cross-language communication.
input.additional_context: The product is entering the US market. Competitors have a strong Amazon presence. We want to test Reddit and TikTok.

input.product_description: An AI meeting assistant that transcribes calls and turns decisions into assigned action items.
input.target_audience: Remote product teams at early-stage SaaS companies
input.additional_context: The team wants to test Product Hunt and LinkedIn. Buyers may already use meeting transcription tools.

input.product_description: A collaborative AI writing workspace that helps small marketing teams turn briefs into review-ready drafts.
input.target_audience: Marketing teams of three to ten people at B2B software companies
input.additional_context: Free-trial signups are growing, but few teams invite a second collaborator or upgrade within the first month.

input.product_description: A mobile language-learning app that creates short daily speaking exercises from topics the learner selects.
input.target_audience: Working adults learning English for international meetings
input.additional_context: Learners complete several sessions in the first week, then usage declines. The team has not yet interviewed churned users.

input.product_description: A desktop editor that converts long-form creator videos into short clips with captions and suggested hooks.
input.target_audience: Independent video creators publishing weekly on YouTube
input.additional_context: The beta has twenty invited creators. The launch will begin with a waitlist and creator walkthrough videos.

input.product_description: A community platform where developers share reusable AI-agent workflows and implementation notes.
input.target_audience: Software engineers building their first production AI agents
input.additional_context: Most current visitors read public workflows but do not publish, comment, or return the following week.

input.product_description: An adaptive desk light that adjusts brightness and color temperature based on work patterns and room conditions.
input.target_audience: Hybrid knowledge workers improving their home-office setup
input.additional_context: The brand is unknown in Germany and wants to explain the category before emphasizing smart features.

input.product_description: An AI note application that automatically organizes captured ideas into connected topics.
input.target_audience: Busy professionals who take many notes

input.product_description: A lightweight product analytics dashboard for founders who need weekly activation and retention signals.
input.target_audience: Seed-stage B2B SaaS founders without a dedicated data analyst
input.additional_context: The founder keeps describing the campaign as a brand-awareness push, but the selected goal for this brief is converting existing trial users.

input.product_description: An edge-AI camera system that flags visual anomalies on small manufacturing production lines.
input.target_audience: Operations managers at small component manufacturers
input.additional_context: The product is entering a paid pilot. Installation requires a short line stoppage, and the team has no published case study yet.

input.product_description: A localization workflow platform that coordinates product strings, translator review, and release approvals.
input.target_audience: Product operations teams at mid-sized software companies expanding across Europe
input.additional_context: Customers involve product managers, engineers, and external translators. Renewal risk appears after teams encounter repeated integration and approval delays.

input.product_description: An audio app offering short guided reflection and planning sessions designed for public-transit commutes.
input.target_audience: Office workers with long weekday public-transit commutes
input.additional_context: The product is not a medical or therapy service. The initial message focuses on arriving at work or home with a clearer plan.
